result.summary: Design written to lib/letflow/design/iss0923-catalog-delete-blocks-on-pinned-instances.md (design only, no implementation code). Decisions: (a) BLOCK via a second guard in ServiceCatalog.delete/1; (b) error {:error, {:referenced_by_active_instances, %{instance_ids: [uuid] (cap 50, ascending, flat), truncated: boolean}}}, no tenant ids, no totals, justified against INV-1/2/5/7/8; (c) :error instances BLOCK (non-terminal == not InstanceProjection.terminal?/1 = :active + :error); (d) order: not_found, active-definitions guard, instances guard (first failing only; definitions-first makes the instance set stable); (e) TOCTOU accepted and documented, no lock (Engine.create does not touch the catalog row, so a lock would not serialize the racer; retire is the safe alternative); (f) orphaned service_catalog_versions rows IN SCOPE: deleted with the entry in one transaction (versions first), stale-entry still maps to :not_found, no FK/migration; reason: re-register-same-id trap and stale {:version, v} pin resolution to a previous incarnation; (g) only caller is Routers.AdminServices.handle_delete (no catch-all => CaseClauseError without a clause): new Error.service_referenced_by_active_instances/1 (409, type service-referenced-by-active-instances, extensions instance_ids + truncated); no OpenAPI file and no web/src consumer exist; doc pointers in req192 routes design and iss0917 OQ-3; (h) @spec union and @doc rewritten; (i) 14 testable ACs (AC-1..AC-14), fixtures from engine_catalog_service_task_test.exs, fail-first set, 7 mutants, MIX_TEST_PARTITION required for committed-row delete tests (shared letflow_test DB 42P01 hazard). Follow-ups noted, not in scope: update_scope/2 narrowing has the same blind spot for running instances; engine-side lock at instance start. No open question blocks implementation; REVIEWER to confirm cap=50 and the two-table write set.
